lesson_title: Endpoints, SDKs, and lightweight client flow
learner_starting_state: Can run Python, use variables and dictionaries, read environment variables, and explain request versus response.
learner_ending_state: Can trace a Foundry client call, distinguish project endpoint from model/deployment name, run the offline simulation, and identify the credential boundary in a current official client pattern.
mastery_gate: Earn at least 8 of 10 points with no endpoint/deployment or secret-handling critical miss, then explain the request-response flow without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: Current SDK and endpoint claims cite the official Foundry SDK overview; simulated behavior is explicitly labeled.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Treat UI, package versions, model names, and authentication details as volatile and reverify before live use.

notes: Offline simulation is required. Live Azure extension is optional and must follow current official documentation.
